name: dpi-controle-de-estoque
description: Sistema de controle de estoque e maquinário para gráfica / comunicação visual.
author: Felipe Neneu Desenvolvedor

scripts.lint: npm --prefix grafica-app run lint && npm --prefix grafica-app/backend run lint
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:export && npm run build:backend && npm --prefix electron run start:server
scripts.e2e:build: npm run build:export && npm run build:backend
scripts.package:electron: npm run package:server && npm run package:client
scripts.package:server: npm run build:export && npm run build:backend && npm --prefix electron run package:server
scripts.package:client: npm run build:export && npm --prefix electron run package:client
